```yaml
name: Publish

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v0.28.1'

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          cache: true

      - name: Install ic-wasm
        run: |
          curl -fsSL https://sdk.dfinity.org/install.sh | bash
          source ~/.bashrc

      - name: Build and publish crates
        run: |
          cargo login ${{ secrets.CRATES_IO_API_TOKEN }}
          cargo publish --manifest-path ic-asset/Cargo.toml
          cargo publish --manifest-path icx-asset/Cargo.toml

      - name: Clean up
        run: rm -rf ~/.cargo/registry ~/.rustup
```

This workflow file sets up a GitHub Actions job to publish the `ic-asset` and `icx-asset` crates to crates.io when a new tag matching `v0.28.1` is pushed to the repository. It uses the `actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1` action to set up the Rust environment with caching enabled, installs the DFINITY SDK using the provided installer script, builds the crates, logs into crates.io using the API token stored as a secret, and then publishes the crates. Finally, it cleans up the Rust environment by removing the registry and rustup directories.
